Introduction

You live in a world where every step you take is dictated by someone else. We buy things we don’t need to impress people we don’t care about. Work, pay, sleep—on repeat, until forgotten.

But not here.

We break the boundaries—we shatter everything that tried to hold us back. In our club, there are no bosses, no loans, no status games. We don’t need approval. Here, we make the rules.

Do you feel that gap inside? It’s not by accident. You've been fed lies, and you're tired of this endless chase. Stop living someone else’s life. Stop running after illusions.

Here, in this club, you have a chance at reality. You can stay a part of the gray masses—or become the one who makes their own rules. Every punch is your step towards independence. With each fight, you not only move closer to victory, but you also take a step towards real wealth. Here, you can become rich not because you follow someone, but because you fight for your freedom.

 

The club is your right to life, real life. Join us. Liberation awaits you.

 

 

How to Start?

After joining via an invitation, we strongly recommend that you immediately change your login and password and also link and verify your email in your profile. This is necessary to restore access if you lose or forget your password. If you don’t do this, all tokens in your balance may be lost. We guarantee that we will not send you any ads or spam.

 

You can link your email in the "Profile" section — "Account Settings". Enter your email address and click "Send Confirmation". A confirmation link will be sent to your email, and once you follow it, your email will be successfully linked. For this, you will receive tokens as a bonus.

 

Be sure to read the rules and this guide to be as effective as possible.

 

Link your social networks. In addition to receiving tokens, you will also be able to quickly learn about the latest news and hidden offline tasks, completing which will earn significant rewards. And remember Rule 4: If you have something to say—say it.

We also strongly recommend replenishing your balance with at least 10 dollars. Otherwise, you will have to maintain daily activity—trainings, fights, or completing tasks. If you are inactive every day, 10 dollars will be deducted from your balance.

However, after topping up and achieving the "Meatloaf" achievement, whether you are active every day or not, inactivity penalties will no longer apply. During the pre-launch stage, this is a small amount, but it will help our club exclude bots and dishonest participants and give you the opportunity to participate freely in the life of the club.

 

After completing all the recommended steps, you can start training, fighting, inviting new members to the club, or creating your own club. For each fight that takes place in your club, you will receive 7.5% of the stake. Read more about clubs, trainings, and fights in the respective sections of this guide.

 

Keep a close eye on the launch timer. It’s not just a countdown. It’s a countdown to when everything changes. Every fight, every action is a step up the ladder that leads to something greater. What is it? You’ll find out when the time comes.

 

Before the launch, you and your club need to climb as high as possible in the tournament rankings. Everything will be evaluated, even what you might not notice yourself. The best will find themselves in places where no one has been before. But don’t try to understand everything at once. Just fight, train, bring people in, and step by step you will get closer to what really matters.

 

 

Cryptocurrency

Cryptocurrency is the path to freedom. If you haven’t mastered this area yet, now is the time to start. But be cautious: the world of cryptocurrency is full of scammers and scam projects that undermine its true principles. Trust only verified sources. Don’t take anyone’s word for it and don’t fall for easy promises. Follow our groups—we will be publishing useful materials to help newcomers understand crypto.

 

In Hexlash, you can connect any wallet from the list on the "Profile" page — "Wallet Management". To do this, select "Connect Wallet," and its public address will appear in the text field. Once connected, you can top up your game balance or withdraw earned tokens.

 

You can top up your balance with any amount from 10 to 5000 dollars—these limits only apply during the pre-launch phase. Click "Top up balance," choose a cryptocurrency from the list, and enter the amount. Then confirm the action, and the transaction will be created. You will be redirected to your wallet for confirmation.

At the moment, we are working with the Ethereum blockchain and ERC-20 tokens, but stay tuned for updates—in the future, we plan to integrate with other blockchains.

 

To withdraw tokens, click on the game balance card, enter the withdrawal amount in the modal window, and confirm the action. The transaction will be processed within one hour, while club withdrawals are processed in 24 hours. The transaction fee ranges from 1% to 3%.

 

Important: withdrawals are not available during the pre-launch phase.

 

 

Trainings

 

Training is your path to fitness and tokens. For each hit on the punching bag, you’ll earn between 2 to 20 cents, depending on the equipment used. If you hit a special zone, which moves around the bag as a circle, your earnings will triple for each precise strike.

 

The punching bag is available in the training room, which you can find in the bottom menu—section "Trainings". Keep in mind that training time is limited every day, so don’t waste a minute—try to get the most out of the bag each time.

 

If the 3D punching bag mode is too heavy for your device, you can switch to 2D mode in the "Profile" section — "Settings". This will reduce the load on your phone and ensure comfortable training.

 

During the pre-launch phase, training, and the punching bag in particular, are part of the AirDrop system. This is your chance to become part of Hexlash, even if you don’t yet understand all the nuances of working with cryptocurrencies. You’ll be able to earn crypto without complex steps at the start and gradually immerse yourself in the learning process. We understand how important this is, as each of us has gone through it.

 

 

Tasks

 

In Hexlash, there are two categories of tasks: daily tasks and the mandatory task checklist. They are all located in the training room, in the bottom menu section—"Trainings".

 

Daily tasks, as the name suggests, change every day and offer you a variety of activities. The task checklist, though it may change, remains more stable and is important to complete.

 

Tasks can be of different types: leave a comment on social media, land a certain number of hits on the punching bag, complete a specific number of fights, watch a video, or join a club on social media. You’ll receive a reward for each completed task.

 

Rewards are processed in two modes:

 

Automatic — for tasks completed within the app.

Semi-automatic — with subsequent verification by a bot or moderator.

 

But remember one rule that is most important: "Be honest with your own." This is the third rule of Hexlash. Any attempt to deceive the club will result in an immediate ban. And this is not just talk.

 

For example, if you joined our group on social media, received a reward, and then left—that’s a violation. It doesn’t matter if it’s after a day, a week, or a month. As long as you’re in the club, you must keep your word. Our bot tracks violations and reports them to the moderation team. They are members of the club just like you, and they don’t tolerate those who don’t keep their word.

 

If the violation is confirmed, your account will be permanently banned. All your victories will be nullified, and your club's rating will be recalculated without your participation. You will disappear from us like a ghost.

 

 

Fights

 

Fights during the pre-launch phase use a simplified combat system, where within a limited time you must choose defensive actions for your avatar and offensive actions for your opponent's avatar.

 

Available actions:

HD (Head Defence): head defense 
BD (Body Defence): body defense 
HH (Head Hit): head hit 
BH (Body Hit): body hit


After both players select their actions, the system compares them. The winner is the one who landed more hits and blocked the opponent’s attacks.

 

Example:
You: HD, HH, BD
Opponent: HH, BD, BH


Result: you landed 1 hit and blocked 2 of the opponent’s hits.
Winner: You.

 

Important: you cannot choose only offensive or only defensive actions—one of the actions must be the opposite.

 

Fight Setup


Before the fight starts, you configure the parameters using three vertical sliders:

 

Bet: Selected in FC tokens of the club. There must be enough tokens on the balance for the bet.


Number of actions: This is the number of moves that you and your opponent will be able to make. Available options: 3, 5, or 10.


Time: The time in which you must complete all actions. For example, you chose 5 actions and 10 seconds to execute. If you don’t manage to complete all 5 actions in the allotted time, the remaining moves will be considered missed, and the opponent’s hits may go through.

 

After configuring the sliders on the "arena", you press "Start Fight," and your request is placed into a special pool. Within 10 seconds, the system will match you with an opponent with similar bets and parameters.

 

While the system automatically matches opponents, duels are planned to be introduced. All innovations are discussed in our social networks, so don’t be indifferent—participate, suggest your ideas, and remember the fourth rule.

 

Fight results:


The winner takes everything, minus the commission, which is distributed between their club and the Hexlash pool. The commission is 7.5% of the winnings. Tokens from the common pool are used to maintain a $1 price—the system burns them to keep the token’s value stable.

 

 

Clubs

 

Clubs are an integral part of every member. You can’t just walk in from the street and create your own club—you need to be invited. From the very beginning of your journey, you are already part of someone else’s club. You can help develop it with others, or if you feel ready for more, create your own club and manage it. It all depends on your determination.

 

Creating a Club

To create your own club, you must have at least 1000 FC tokens in your balance. You only get one chance to create a club. In your profile, next to your current club’s button, there will be a "Create Club" button. By clicking it, you can come up with a name and description for your club. Once the club is created, your personal invitation code will redirect participants to your new club. Everyone you invite will become its members.

 

Club Owner’s Income

As a club owner, you will earn a percentage from all the fights that take place in the club. This income can be withdrawn to your crypto wallet just like personal withdrawals. To withdraw funds, go to the club page, click "Balance," enter the amount in the modal window, and confirm the action.

 

You can change the club’s name, description, and avatar, but remember: offensive or disrespectful names are prohibited. Running a club is not just a source of income and reputation, but also a responsibility. You become part of Hexlash and represent it in your city, district, and community.

 

Public and Private Clubs

You can make your club private, meaning that only people with your invitation code can join. If the club is public, every member can share their invitation code with others, allowing them to join your club.

 

If you decide to leave your club and join another, your invitation code will start working for the new club you join.

 

Joining a Club

In addition to creating a club, you can join any other club if you have an invitation code. To see the club members, simply click the corresponding button, and you will be redirected to the club’s members page.

 

Tips

For information about each section, click on the icons—they will give you helpful tips.

 

 

Profile

 

Your profile is your reflection in the club, your digital shadow. It stores all your stats: number of fights, victories, draws, losses, luck percentage, how many tokens you’ve earned in the arena and through training. It also tracks all the members you’ve invited, as long as they’ve not only joined but also fought at least once. Time spent in the club, days when you didn’t skip training or fights—all of this is tracked. Stats are your mark. Every fighter is evaluated based on them, and this determines your significance for the club.

 

But don’t be afraid if something goes wrong. Your losses don’t define you. The more you participate in tasks, bring in new members, and stay active, the higher your importance will be. Each of us has our own talents, and the fighter rankings are balanced to reveal your true strength. It’s not just about how many punches you land but how you play the long game. Everything you do leaves a mark.

 

Achievements aren’t just medals. They highlight your strengths and show others where you excel. Some achievements are always visible, but many are hidden, just like your true nature, until you reach the moment of revelation. You’ll see them when you’re ready, but not before.

 

Your invitation code is your key, a way to invite others to join your club. This code only works for the club you’re a part of. If the club is private, no one can join using your code—only with the owner’s approval. If you decide to create your own club, the code will belong to you, and then everyone you invite will become part of your world. For more information, see the "Clubs" section.

 

Button Panel

 

Go to Club: Opens the doors to your club. If you’re an admin, you’ll have access to edit information and withdraw the funds earned by your club.

 

Wallet Management: Allows you to top up your balance or withdraw funds. For more details, see the "Cryptocurrency" section.

 

Settings / Skins / More: This is your personal settings area where you can change key parameters:

 

Skin: It determines how you look in fights. But remember, this is not just a choice of appearance—it’s the image you create. During the pre-launch, only 2D skins are available, and some require FC tokens. This is not a one-time purchase. If you choose a skin for 200 FC tokens and then decide to change it, you will need to pay 200 FC tokens again to return to the previous skin. Everything here has a price, and every choice leaves a mark.

 

Email: This is an important step to secure access to your account. Ignoring it means risking everything you’ve earned. Enter your email and click "Send Confirmation." This is your word, confirmed by a link in your email.

 

Login: The name everyone will see. From 3 to 32 characters. The name you choose defines your presence. Click the pencil icon and confirm your new name. Remember, your old profile link will stop working once you change your login.

 

Language Selection: You can set any language. If you want to help the club, offer your assistance with translations. This is not just a choice—it’s a contribution to the common cause. The club won’t forget your participation.

 

3D Bag: Here, you can switch the bag display mode to 2D or 3D. This is needed to tailor the training to your device. But know, this is not just a visual setting—it’s part of your journey.

 

Bag Selection: Here, you can choose equipment for training. More advanced equipment brings up to 20 cents per hit, but access is granted only to trusted members. Can you be one of them?

 

Change Password: This is the key to your world. Choose it wisely. Enter your old password and the new one twice to protect your account from those who want to invade your digital fortress.

 

Delete Account: If you give up, this button will end your journey. All club obligations to you will cease to exist, as will you for the club. We may keep your account locked for 30 days to investigate fraud, after which everything will disappear forever. You will become a ghost.

 

 

Rules / Help: Here you’ll find all the rules. Study them carefully—following the club’s rules defines your membership. Only those who know and respect the rules remain part of the club.

 

Logout: When you press this button, you’ll log out of your account on this device. Make sure you remember your login and password, especially if you’ve recently joined. Otherwise, you may lose access to the club.

 

 

Ratings

 

Ratings are where you can see the results of both individual fighters and clubs in the team standings. Ratings can be sorted for clubs by victories or total number of fights, and for participants—by victories, total number of fights, losses, luck percentage, and tokens earned.

 

The "Ratings" page displays basic metrics, but as mentioned in the "Profile" section, it doesn’t fully reveal a fighter’s personality. A participant may not have the highest rating, yet still be a key player in the club or even its owner. It’s important to remember that the rating is just part of the story. However, for every fighter, it’s crucial to strive for high results, especially as the end of the countdown approaches.

 

By clicking on a participant’s name or a club’s name in the table, you’ll open their detailed page where you can learn more about them.

 


If you haven’t familiarized yourself with the "rules" yet, be sure to do so!
